entries.title: Futuristic macOS 27-Style Custom Dock with Widgets

Around 2 weeks ago, i decided to build a LLMs usage tracker.

I named it Codenotch.
Insane how other devs improve Codenotch using their own creativity and keep adding more features and providers since i decided to open-source this tool so anyone can help to add providers i don't use. Until this time, Codenotch is available for V1.12.0.

For those asking where to get Codenotch: httLOCAL_ASSET_NOT_DISTRIBUTED
